title: dianthus alpinus var. glacialis
intro: Dianthus alpinus var. glacialis, commonly known as Glacier Pink, is a variety of the Dianthus alpinus plant, which is a type of flowering perennial native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is said to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus alpinus var. glacialis include its ability to reduce fever, calm the nervous system, and promote digestion. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
